title: Palindrome Check
description: Check if a string is a palindrome
instructions:
Create a function called `is_palindrome()` that checks if a string reads the same forwards and backwards. Ignore spaces and case.

**Requirements:**
- Function name: `is_palindrome`
- Parameter: `text` (string)
- Returns: `True` or `False`
- Ignore spaces and case

**Example:**
```python
is_palindrome('racecar')  # Returns True
is_palindrome('hello')    # Returns False
is_palindrome('A man a plan a canal Panama')  # Returns True
```
starter_code: def is_palindrome(text):\n    # Write your code here\n    pass
solution:
def is_palindrome(text):
    # Remove spaces and convert to lowercase
    clean = text.replace(' ', '').lower()
    return clean == clean[::-1]
